industry: Cash home buyers / 'We Buy Houses' investors and wholesalers (mail aimed at homeowners who might sell)
words_and_claims_to_avoid: 'URGENT NOTICE', 'FINAL NOTICE' (GOLD-004, GOLD-012), case/reference numbers, seals, or layouts that look like a lender, court, county or government notice (39 USC 3001(h); FTC s.5).
'Stop foreclosure' / 'save your home' / 'we'll stop the auction' (MARS/Reg O: no results claims; required disclosures).
'Highest price', 'top dollar', 'fair market value' for a discounted cash offer (sellers typically get less; iBuyer discount ~3.6%).
'No fees' if there are any deductions, closing costs or assignment spreads.
'We're buying, not wholesaling' if the contract will be assigned.
Naming private distress facts ('we see you're behind on taxes'), or 'sinkhole/bankruptcy/foreclosure' lists that read as accusations (GOLD-008).
'Seniors: downsize now' and other age/familial-status targeting (Fair Housing / no evidence).
Fake handwritten 'I drove by and loved your house' if nobody did.
compliance_notes: Government/lender look-alike: 39 USC 3001(h) - anything implying government connection must carry the disclaimer; avoid notice-style design entirely. FTC Act s.5 covers lender/court look-alikes.

Foreclosure rescue (MARS, Reg O 12 CFR 1015): if the mail mentions avoiding foreclosure or saving the home, required disclosures include that you are not associated with the government or the lender, and you can't claim results or take advance fees. Purely 'we buy your house' offers may fall outside, but distress-list mail often drifts in; counsel should review.

California Home Equity Sales Contracts Act (Civ. Code 1695 et seq.): buying a residence in foreclosure (NOD recorded) requires specific contract language and a 5-business-day cancellation right; violations carry heavy liability.

Wholesaler laws: Oklahoma SB 1075 (eff. Nov 1 2025) requires written disclosure of intent to assign, advice to seek counsel, and 2-business-day cancellation. Pennsylvania Act 52 of 2024 brings wholesaling under license law with wholesale-contract disclosures and a 30-day cancellation right. Illinois: marketing or dealing in assignable contracts 2+ times in 12 months requires a broker license (225 ILCS 454/1-10). Philadelphia also licenses wholesalers. Other states are adding rules; check yearly.

Fair Housing Act applies to purchases of dwellings: don't target or exclude by protected class (including selecting neighborhoods as racial proxies); interpretation for investor-buyer mail should be confirmed by counsel.
Testimonials and 'we've bought 500 homes' claims: substantiation, real and typical (16 CFR 255).
TCPA/DNC for follow-up calls and texts (skip-traced numbers are high-risk).
'$500 bonus cash at closing' (GOLD-001, 017): state real-estate inducement rules may apply if licensed; disclose conditions.
standing_rules: Emotion-agnostic: fear, joy, pride, status, relief, nostalgia are all options; the client chooses.
Every angle and combo carries a sell-the-outcome line.
Unverified (agency/vendor-only) results are labeled; never quote them as fact on a card.
No age/demographic angle unless a cited source supports it for this industry; even then, check Fair Housing / ECOA before using it in housing or credit.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Gold 'URGENT NOTICE' / 'FINAL NOTICE!' cards (GOLD-004, 012) vs 39 USC 3001(h) and FTC deception
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Law wins: no notice-style designs; urgency via real reasons (your date, fast close).

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Gold 'any condition (foreclosure, sinkhole, bankruptcy)' (GOLD-008) vs Reg O and respect
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Law wins where foreclosure relief is implied; reframe as 'any condition, any situation' and add MARS disclosures if foreclosure is named.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: Vendor 'Tired of Tenants?' 5-deal result vs no independent data
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Use as a pattern only; label unverified.

emotion_by_offer_conflicts.conflict: 'Top dollar / fair price' copy vs Buchak et al. (~3.6% discount)
emotion_by_offer_conflicts.resolution: Verified study wins: sell certainty and convenience, not highest price.
